notes: Boot totan_14 from an empty NVRAM, press service Escape once to leave the fresh-NVRAM FACTORY SETTINGS RESTORED / BOOKKEEPING TOTALS CLEARED loop, then observe attract mode for 180 s with no further input. The run records the public G.I. levels 0-4 as the ROM and PinMAME publish them. It observes attract mode only: it does not start a game and traces no gameplay or mode lighting, and it says nothing about which physical bulb sits on which string.
